newsitem.title: EGYPT: EgyptAir plane interrupts flight after brawl.
newsitem.headline: EgyptAir plane interrupts flight after brawl.

text.p: An EgyptAir flight made an emergency landing in Cairo on Monday one hour after takeoff to let off five men who brawled with the passengers and injured a crew member, airport sources said.

They said the unnamed men, Arab citizens whose nationalities could not be immediately confirmed, argued with several passengers while the plane was en route to the Saudi Arabian capital Riyadh. They also hit and slightly wounded a steward, the sources added.
The pilot then asked for permission to return to Cairo airport where policemen arrested four of the men and took the fifth, who appeared to be drunk, to hospital.
